```sql
WITH monthly AS (
  SELECT
    SUM(CASE WHEN strftime('%Y-%m', ordered_at) = '2025-07' THEN subtotal ELSE 0 END) AS july_2025_sales_pretax,
    SUM(CASE WHEN strftime('%Y-%m', ordered_at) = '2025-08' THEN subtotal ELSE 0 END) AS august_2025_sales_pretax
  FROM jaffle_shop.dev.orders
  WHERE strftime('%Y-%m', ordered_at) IN ('2025-07', '2025-08')
)
SELECT
  july_2025_sales_pretax,
  august_2025_sales_pretax,
  august_2025_sales_pretax - july_2025_sales_pretax AS absolute_growth,
  CASE WHEN july_2025_sales_pretax = 0 THEN NULL
       ELSE 100.0 * (august_2025_sales_pretax - july_2025_sales_pretax) / july_2025_sales_pretax
  END AS percentage_growth
FROM monthly
```
